name: grok-desktop
description: Desktop ACP client for grok-build (M0/M1 MVP)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @grok-desktop/acp-core && npm run build -w @grok-desktop/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @grok-desktop/acp-core && npm run test -w @grok-desktop/acp-core && npm run test -w @grok-desktop/bridge --if-present && npm run test -w @grok-desktop/desktop --if-present
scripts.dev:full: echo 'Terminal A: npm run bridge  |  Terminal B: npm run dev  |  UI: Live grok (demo/)'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @grok-desktop/acp-core && npm run typecheck:test -w @grok-desktop/acp-core && npm run typecheck -w @grok-desktop/bridge --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @grok-desktop/desktop --if-present && npm run typecheck:test -w @grok-desktop/desktop --if-present
